=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
File: scripts/ai_memory.py
Line: 113-115
Problem: The `_require_positive_int` call uses the pattern `"8" if push_retries_env is None else push_retries_env`. When `AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES` is explicitly set to an empty string `""`, this passes `""` to validation which raises `MemoryValidationError`. This diverges from `scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py` which uses `_to_int` with a fallback, silently returning the default 8 for empty strings.
Why it fails at runtime: If an operator sets `AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES=""` (intending to use default), ai_memory.py will fail while collect_workflow_logs.py will succeed. However, this behavioral divergence already existed before this PR - the original code `int(os.getenv(...))` would also crash on empty string with ValueError. The PR actually improves error messaging to a clearer MemoryValidationError.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
File: scripts/ai_memory.py
Line or code reference: Lines 112-115, `_read_env_defaults()` function
Problem: Empty string `AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES=""` raises `MemoryValidationError` in `ai_memory.py` but silently falls back to default `8` in `collect_workflow_logs.py`, creating operator-facing behavioral inconsistency for the same environment variable.
Why it fails at runtime: When an operator explicitly sets `AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES=""` (empty string), `_safe_int("")` returns `None` in `ai_memory.py`, causing `_require_positive_int()` to raise `MemoryValidationError` and abort execution. However, in `collect_workflow_logs.py`, the `_to_int()` helper catches the `ValueError` from `int("")` and silently returns the default value `8`. This divergence means operators get a hard failure in the main CLI but silent fallback in the log collector for identical misconfiguration.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
File: scripts/ai_memory.py vs scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py
Line or code reference: ai_memory.py:112-115 (_require_positive_int with empty-string env) vs collect_workflow_logs.py:1308 (_to_int with empty-string env)
Problem: Setting AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES="" (explicit empty string) causes scripts/ai_memory.py to raise MemoryValidationError (since empty string is not None, it is passed through to _require_positive_int, which calls _safe_int("") returning None, then raises), while scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py strips the empty string and falls back to the default 8 (via `str(...).strip() or "ai-memory"`-style logic: `os.getenv("AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES", "8")` returns `""`, which `_to_int` converts to `0` — actually, let me re-check: `_to_int("", 8)` calls `int("")` which raises ValueError, caught, returns 8). The two scripts handle the same malformed env var differently: one fails closed, one fails open.
Why it fails at runtime: An operator who sets `AI_MEMORY_PUSH_RETRIES=""` intending to "clear" it would see the plan/clarify/implement/review phases abort with MemoryValidationError while the log-collection path silently uses 8. This won't cause data corruption, but it creates inconsistent operator experience across the pipeline.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
